sonnet.problem: Card 1 of this stop already has the tribes say twice, "The LORD, the Mighty One, is God!", and card 8 says the altar is a sign that they belong to the LORD. A baker can pick "That the LORD is God" from those cards, not from reasoning. Cards 7 and 17 also already set up the altar as a "witness," so this card nearly re-asks what the altar witnesses to.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
